html:
Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

Past allies become powerful foes!
Past enemies become reliable companions!
Powerful heroes have arrived once again from the Marvel Rivals dimension, 
where fierce battles never cease.

 

In this Update Details, we are introducing the April Update, 
inspired by Marvel Rivals.

 

New Uniforms have been added for Captain America, 
the symbol of freedom and liberation who fights for his country, 
and Venom, the biological weapon born from the union of an alien lifeform and a human.

 

The beloved mascot Super Hero, Jeff the Land Shark, 
has joined the world of MARVEL Future Fight, 
fully prepared with Tier-3 and Tier-4 powers.

 

Furthermore, a Custom Gear Multi-Slot system has been added, 
allowing you to utilize your favorite heroes across a wider variety of game modes.

 

Other improvements to make the game more enjoyable have been added as well, 
so please check the details below!

 

 

 

▣ One New Hero

 

Check out the abilities of Jeff the Land Shark <Marvel Rivals>, 
who fights using his small but sharp teeth and agile movements.
* The skill effects of the new hero are based on the maximum skill level stats.

 

 

 

▣ Two New Uniforms


To celebrate the Marvel Rivals inspired update, two new Uniforms have been added.
Check out the abilities of Captain America <Galactic Talon> and Venom <Snow Symbiote>.
* The skill effects of the new Uniforms are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The two new Uniforms will be on sale for 50% off during the <April Update Celebration Event> and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

 

 

 

▣ Jeff the Land Shark Tier-4

Tier-4 Advancement has been added for Jeff the Land Shark.
He will proudly play his part as a member of the Super Heroes, not just as a mascot.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 


▣ Jeff the Land Shark Tier-3

 

Tier-3 Ultimate Skill has been added for Jeff the Land Shark.
Do not let his cute appearance fool you, or you will be in for a surprise!

 

 

 

 

▣ Kid Kaiju and Inferno Potential Awakening & Transcendence


Check out the Potential Awakening & Potential Transcendence abilities 
for Kid Kaiju and Inferno, added in the April Update.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Feature: [Custom Gear Multi-Slot]

To help you utilize your favorite heroes more effectively in both PVE and PVP, 
the “Custom Gear Multi-Slot” system has been added.

 

 

① Applied Content: Displays which content is assigned to the selected slot.
- By default, Slot 1 applies to both PVE and PVP content.

 

② Slot Number: Slot 1 is provided by default. 
Opening Slot 2 by clicking the '+' button costs 1,000 Crystals.

 

③ Edit Applied Content: Once Slot 2 is unlocked, you can use this button to assign PVE and PVP content to separate slots.
* If you play content assigned to a slot with no Custom Gear equipped, you may be at a disadvantage in battle.
* The Edit button is unavailable until Slot 2 is unlocked.

 

- Content will be applied to the selected slot.

 

In the Manage Custom Gear screen, you can manage Reforging and Option Changes for the Custom Gear equipped in each slot.

 

- The Custom Gear in the selected slot will be the target for management, as shown in the screen above.

 

▶ Additional Improvements
With the addition of Custom Gear multi-slots, the following improvements have been made.

 

① In My Team → Filter, you can now check Slot 1 and Slot 2 gear via the Custom Gear button
- Repeated tapping cycles through: ON(OFF) → Custom Gear 1 → Custom Gear 2.

 

 

② In the Hero Details → Gear menu, you can check stats according to the Custom Gear in each slot.

 

 

 

▣ New Artifacts

 

After the April update, Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for 
Jeff the Land Shark, Kid Kaiju and Inferno will be added.
﻿* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 


▣ New Future Pass Plus Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass Plus will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Plus Rewards]

 

- The Future Pass Plus effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased. 
The Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.
- The Future Pass Plus - Mythic can be purchased after purchasing the Future Pass Plus - Legendary.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic will not be available for purchase when the season is about to end. 

 

​​New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Plus rewards, 
and three more from the upcoming Event!


[April Update New Special Icon]


 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Update Hot Deal Products

 

1.  Update Hot Deal products have been added.
- Event Schedule: 
After the 4/7 Maintenance - 5/5 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 4/7 Maintenance - 5/5 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)
- Find various update celebration products like Hot Deal! 100M Gold Pack, and Hot Deal! Custom Gear Unequip Pack in the Hot Deals category in the Store.
Please check the details in-game after the update.

 

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Heroes already set as a Tier-4 Striker skill for another hero can now be set as a Striker skill for multiple heroes simultaneously. 
- The warning message regarding duplicate hero settings will no longer appear.

 

 

2. A display for the "Recommended Additional Pierce Damage" value has been added to World Boss: Legend mode.
- Tap the '?' button to check the Additional Pierce Damage of each team member.

 

 

3. New effects have been added to specific VIP Levels. 

 

 

- Benefits for the “Recharge 120 Energy" item will be displayed separately if the VIP level requirement is met.

 

4. Alliance Conquest: The Contribution Rewards distributed after the season ends have been improved. 
* The adjusted balance for reward improvements will be applied following the 4/7 (Tue) maintenance.

 

 

5. The acquisition conditions for Potential Realization Points have been eased, 
and the Potential Search gauge has been adjusted to reach 100% upon a single World Boss clear.
For more details, please refer to the notice below.
[Go to → April Regular Update: Potential Realization Improvement Notice]

 

6. S.H.I.E.L.D. Archive: The acquisition chances for certain collection items have been partially increased.

 

7. The following items have been improved to enhance convenience for new Agents during early gameplay.
- A "View Details" button has been added to some Agent Growth Training rewards.
- Unlock conditions for the Content Status Board have been added.
- The sorting condition for owned Comic Cards has been changed to ‘▼ Rank’.
- The ‘Boost ISO-8’ tab is now displayed by default during ISO-8 Awakening/Enhancement.
- Guide Quest: The magnifying glass button for ‘Quest List’ has been changed to a text-based button.
- S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy: The ‘?’ button for ‘Help List’ has been changed to a text-based button.
- Dispatch Mission: An unlock condition for the Auto-Repeat function has been added (Usable after the mission is completed once).

 

8. Store: A menu to skip animations when purchasing items from the Dimension Chest category has been added.

 

9. Game Guide: The contents of the Item Glossary category have been updated.
- Information on Emblem Data and Emblem Enhancement Kits has been added.

 

10. A 'Max' option has been added to Settings - Option - Graphics - 'Performance' and 'Framerate Speed on Auto Repeat.'
- Selecting the 'Max' option allows the frame rate to reach the maximum refresh rate supported by your display.
* This is an experimental feature, and high frame rates may cause device overheating and rapid battery drain.
* High frame rates may not be achieved depending on device performance, system settings, or game optimization tool configurations.

 

11. Venom’s Tier-4 Striker Skill description has been updated.
- Before: A particle of the tissue will fall off. Touching it will result in some health recovery. Recharges Tier-3 Skill Gauge.
- After: A particle of the tissue will fall off. Touching it restores HP and recharges the Ultimate Skill Gauge.
- Before: Recharges Tier-3 Skill Gauge by N%
- After: Recharges the Ultimate Skill Gauge by N%

 

12. A new system has been added where new accounts created after the 4/7 (Tue) maintenance can earn rewards while downloading the game for the first time.
- Rewards: 100 Energy, 1,000,000 Gold, Selector: Tier-2 Character x1, 100 Crystals
- Rewards are calculated based on download progress and will be sent to the Inbox after completing the tutorial. (Available for 7 days from the time of distribution.)
* We have identified an issue where some reward images are swapped on the screen. This will be fixed in a future update.
- Please be assured that all rewards will be distributed correctly upon completion of the download.

 

13. An ‘Exchange Ticket’ button has been added to the Manage Custom Gear screen, allowing you to exchange a selected C.T.P. for a C.T.P. of your choice.
- Three new items, ‘Normal / Mighty / Brilliant C.T.P. Selection Exchange Tickets’, have been added through 4/7 (Tue) update.
- If you possess one of these tickets, you can use the ‘Exchange Ticket’ button to exchange a C.T.P. for another C.T.P. of the same rank.
- Details on how to obtain C.T.P. Selection Exchange Tickets will be shared through future product and event announcements.
 


▣ Game Error Fixes


1. Notation errors for the C.T.P. of Liberation have been fixed.
Please note that these were display issues only; the actual effects were functioning correctly.
- An issue where the tooltip for the "Increase all damage dealt to all Instincts" effect would not update when the "Buff Effect Increase" was applied has been fixed.
- An issue where the "HP Increase" effect was not reflected in the HP stats under the Gear tab in the Hero Details screen has been fixed.


2. An issue where the highest value was not applied when multiple identical C.T.P. effects were active simultaneously has been fixed.


3. An issue where tooltips would reset upon tagging out if the “Buff Effect Increase” effect was included in a Uniform effect has been fixed.


4. An issue where certain abilities were not applied when using the Striker Skill after setting Mantis <Marvel Studios’ Guardians of the Galaxy 3> as a Tier-4 Striker has been fixed.


5. An issue where the activation effect of the C.T.P. of Judgment from a Striker was only applied during their first appearance has been fixed.

 


We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.


Thank you.
